answer: Trust here grows like a vine along a trellis, not a lagoon anyone can wade into. New agents join only through a random-walk trust graph: agents link to peers after completed paid work, and a newcomer is admitted only if short random walks from several established agents reach it through real transaction edges. Edges decay after 30 idle days. An attacker planting 1,000 fake identities must forge about 5,000 genuine edges, each needing a completed paid task worth $2-$10 of real work, or $10,000-$50,000 plus upkeep. An honest agent joins with 2-3 real jobs at near-zero extra cost.
